# Lab 16.15: Store & Access Secrets

## What We Are Going to Do
Store a password in Secret Manager, give one service access, use it from Cloud Run, then rotate it.

## Steps

1. **Create a secret and a first version.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud services enable secretmanager.googleapis.com
printf "S3cure-Pass-v1" | gcloud secrets create db-pass \
  --replication-policy=user-managed --locations=us-central1 --data-file=-</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Read it as yourself.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud secrets versions access latest --secret=db-pass</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Create a service account for the app and grant access to this secret only.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud iam service-accounts create secret-app
gcloud secrets add-iam-policy-binding db-pass \
  --member=serviceAccount:secret-app@$PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Use it from Cloud Run.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud run deploy secret-demo --region=us-central1 \
  --image=us-docker.pkg.dev/cloudrun/container/hello \
  --service-account=secret-app@$PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --set-secrets=DB_PASS=db-pass:latest \
  --no-allow-unauthenticated</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The value is injected as an environment variable at start-up. It is never in the image or the code.

5. **Rotate the secret.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">printf "S3cure-Pass-v2" | gcloud secrets versions add db-pass --data-file=-
gcloud secrets versions disable 1 --secret=db-pass
gcloud secrets versions list db-pass</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   New Cloud Run instances read version 2. Pinning a version number instead of `latest` gives you control over when apps switch.

6. **See who read it.** Turn on **Data Read** audit logs for Secret Manager, then search for `AccessSecretVersion` in **Logs Explorer**.

7. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud run services delete secret-demo --region=us-central1 --quiet
gcloud secrets delete db-pass --quiet
gcloud iam service-accounts delete secret-app@$PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com --quiet</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Secret in code | None |
| Access | One service account, one secret |
| Rotation | New version, old one disabled |
| Location | Stored only in `us-central1` |
